icons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE individual square PNG ability icon for Minecraft mod Mysteries Above, continuing the approved Door Blink icon visible in conversation. Match its chunky high quality pixel art, dark field, luminous cyan magic and thin square silver gunmetal frame. Deliver one icon filling the whole square canvas, no presentation, margins, grid, sheet or montage. Disciplined 32 by 32 logical pixel sprite magnified using nearest-neighbor square blocks, no subpixel detail, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, painting or 3D rendering. A plain straight one-logical-pixel desaturated silver gunmetal bevel exactly on the canvas edges, pale upper/left sides, charcoal lower/right sides, one dark inset. The main silhouette fills about 24 of 32 logical pixels and must read at 16x16. Large bold solid clusters, stepped shadow ramps, controlled local glow without fuzzy bloom. Door palette: exact base #6AE6F7 (106,230,247), secondary #55FFFF, pale ice highlights #E2FDFF, deep teal shadows #134756 and near-black #071318 background. Predominantly turquoise and icy cyan, not cobalt blue, violet, yellow, green or orange. No writing, letters, digits, text, glyph-like runes, logos, watermarks, tiny noisy sparks, ornate corners. Give this particular ability its own unique silhouette and composition.
Ability identity: door_opening. Actual ability: Door Opening makes a traversable temporary door through a solid wall, limited by the thickness of the wall. Subject: a thick masonry wall shown in three-quarter cutaway, taking up most of the icon. In its front face a single angular cyan arch has split open, one slab of the wall swinging outward on its jamb, revealing a short glowing passage through visible thick stone blocks. The opening is dark hollow at center with bright cyan edges; stones dark charcoal-teal. Show physical WALL THICKNESS, not a free-standing portal or two doorways. Broad block silhouette with a bright cut through it.
icons.name: Відкриття дверей
